hints.title: Cyclic Shift Equivalence
hints.text: A row of length n shifted left or right by k positions remains unchanged if and only if mat[i][j] equals mat[i][(j + k) % n] for all column indices j.

hints.title: Row Comparison
hints.text: Compare each element with the element k indices ahead cyclically within the same row.

hints.title: Full Matrix Invariance
hints.text: If any cell violates the equality, return false immediately; otherwise return true.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass coordinate comparison across matrix.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all k step rotations individually is redundant.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use modular arithmetic to compare original and shifted elements directly.
